text:
Elena CSM: Heads-up — AuroraCorp's usage dropped ~65% this week after their procurement team paused API keys. Renewal in 6w. We have a competitive pilot running with Nimbus; procurement says they're re-evaluating because of legal + telemetry concerns.
Ravi AE: Met with their buyer. Main asks: data residency, ability to schedule on-prem snapshot, and whether we can provide an audit-ready request export. They're worried about third-party tracing libs flagged by security review.
Marta (Aurora PM): Sorry team 8094 legal pulled scope back. They requested a 14-day hold while GC reviews our subprocessors list and a sample logs extract. Also flagged that some teams saw increased 5xxs last week.
Liam Support: We saw a spike of 500s for a brief window on 2026-03-12 02:00-02:12 UTC. Logs: ```[2026-03-12T02:05:11Z] ERROR 500 gateway Timeout while calling model-backend``` Ticket #4982 opened.
Sam SE: Quick options: 1) Provide sanitized 30-day request export (PII redacted) 2) Offer temporary on-prem snapshot for compliance review 3) Propose a short MSA addendum limiting subprocessors for Aurora. Also can run a quick infra healthcheck to address 5xxs.
Elena CSM: Proposed triage play: A) 24h turnaround for sanitized logs + infra health summary, B) Draft an MSA addendum sample for GC, C) Offer 30-day seat credit + free technical health review, D) Put Nimbus competitive pilot on hold while legal reviews. Thoughts? :pray:
Ravi AE: Agree. I'm fine with seat credit. Need contracts-bot to draft a narrow addendum (no price changes) that restricts data sharing and confirms retention policy.
contracts-bot: Draft addendum v0.1 uploaded: https://files.redwood.dev/addendum/aurora-v0.1.pdf
Marta (Aurora PM): Can you also include proof of encryption-at-rest and key ownership (KMS)? GC asked for that specifically.
Sam SE: Will include a short KMS summary and a sanitized logs schema. Also adding a config snippet for a private endpoint we can spin up: ```# create private endpoint
curl -X POST https://infra.redwood.dev/endpoints -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"type":"vpc","customer":"aurora","expires":"2026-04-15T00:00:00Z"}'``` 
Liam Support: Healthcheck results: no recurring errors after the 12th, root cause was a backfill job that overloaded workers. Mitigation applied and rate-limiter adjusted. I'll attach the results to ticket #4982.
Elena CSM: Great. Meeting proposal: Fri 09:00 PT with Aurora GC, procurement, Marta, + our security + contracts. Ravi to lead commercial, Sam to run tech. I'll send calendar invite.
Ravi AE: I'll ask procurement to pause the Nimbus evaluation for now. If Aurora signs the addendum, we can reaccelerate.
Marta (Aurora PM): Please send the sanitized sample before Fri so GC can pre-review. If they like it, we may skip the hold.
Elena CSM: Action items: Elena will send agenda + invite; Sam to upload sanitized export (ETA 8h); Liam to post ticket update and attach the infra healthcheck; contracts-bot will iterate addendum; Ravi to coordinate pause on competitive pilot. Will update thread when items are posted. :white_check_mark:
